none: No 3D model is available for your motors yet.
inPreparation: 3D model for this motor is in preparation.
measureHint: Click two points on the model
downloadSimplifiedTip: The envelope-only model: stator, rotor and magnets as one solid, each coil as one block, bearings as rings. Open to every signed-in user, no NDA. The file is stamped "SIMPLIFIED - envelope only" and the download is logged.
stamped: Your name, company, the date and your NDA are written into the file name and the STEP header. Every download is logged.
contextLost: The 3D view lost its graphics context. Reload the page to continue.
downloadLockedHelp: You can view, rotate, section and measure the model. The tools and the STEP download open when the NDA is signed and we have checked who is asking (usually a few minutes; no passport or ID is needed). Every download is logged and the file carries your name and the date.

nda.title: Non-disclosure agreement
nda.accept: I have read and accept the agreement and am authorised to sign for the company
nda.typeName: Type your full name to sign
nda.disabled: Online signing is not open yet.
nda.disabledHelp: The agreement text is still a draft. It will open as soon as the final text is published.

errors.country: Choose a country from the list
errors.name: Must match the signatory name

nda.verifyHelp: Before the 3-D tools and the STEP download open we check the company and the person - a routine step that protects our customers' designs. It usually takes a few minutes; if we need more, we write to you. We never ask for a passport or an ID.

verification.title: Verification
verification.inProgressHelp: You signed the NDA. We are checking the company and your details, or our team is looking at them. The 3-D tools and the STEP download open as soon as this is done; we write to you if we need anything.
verification.needInfo: We need one more thing from you
verification.needInfoHelp: We need a specific proof to finish the check - for example a corporate e-mail address or a link to a page of your company that lists you. Open the page to see what and answer there; no sign-in is needed.
verification.deniedHelp: We could not open the 3-D tools for this account. If you think this is a mistake, reply to our e-mail or contact support.
